cpmplus.w34proa.ground.menu.desc: Shows a checkered floor that moves backwards at Minecraft's speed while the animation plays (or while you drag the playhead). A foot on the ground must move along with the squares; if it slides, the stride does not match the speed. View only: the model does not change.
cpmplus.w34proa.ground.onHint: Moving ground on (%s). Play the animation: a foot on the ground must move along with the squares. Change it in CPM+ > Animation > Ground speed.
cpmplus.w34proa.ground.speed.menu.desc: Picks the speed of the 'Moving ground' and of the 'foot sliding' warning (Check motion): automatic from the animation's state or a fixed one.
cpmplus.w34proa.ground.speed.title: Ground speed
cpmplus.w34proa.ground.speed.intro: The floor moves backwards at this speed while the animation plays. 'Automatic' uses the animation's CPM state: walking, running or sneak walking (the others stand still). 1 block = 16 px.
cpmplus.w34proa.ground.speed.label: Speed
cpmplus.w34proa.slip.row: Foot sliding: '%s' slides up to %s px while the foot is on the ground (%s). The floor moves at %s blocks/s: while the foot is planted it must move backwards at that speed. Adjust the stride or the length.
cpmplus.w34proa.slip.additive: Foot sliding not checked on Minecraft's legs in '%s': the animation is additive, so the game adds its own leg swing (which the preview does not show). Make the animation non-additive to control the whole step.
cpmplus.w34proa.split.menu.desc: CPM takes up to 255 moving parts per animation (the 256th becomes part 0 in game). Splits it into animations that play together on the same button, each bone chain whole in one piece.
cpmplus.w34proa.split.title: Split big animation
cpmplus.w34proa.split.intro: '%s' moves %s parts. CPM stores how many parts an animation moves in 1 byte: above 255, the 256th part lands on part 0 in game.
cpmplus.w34proa.split.plan: It becomes %s animations that play together, on the same button and with the same settings (type, additive, loop, length, frames per second, priority, layer). Each bone chain stays whole in one piece:
cpmplus.w34proa.split.planStaged: It is an entry/exit: it becomes %s animations with the SAME name (CPM joins entries and exits by name). Each bone chain stays whole in one piece:
cpmplus.w34proa.split.done: '%s' split into %s animations that play together
cpmplus.w34proa.split.err.fits: '%s' already fits: up to 255 moving parts. No need to split.
cpmplus.w34proa.split.err.customPose: '%s' is a custom pose: CPM links custom poses by the whole name, so 'Name#b' would become another pose with another button. To split it, change the type to gesture or layer, or let fewer parts move.
cpmplus.w34proa.split.err.notFound: Could not find the animation '%s' in the project.
cpmplus.w34proa.split.time: '%s' is also over the time limit (%s frames, %s). That cannot be split into pieces that play one after another on the same button: in CPM the entry (setup) and the middle start together when you press it, the middle is cut at its own length counted from the press, and the exit (finish) only plays when you switch the gesture off. Use 'Adjust' on the export warning (fewer frames per second), 'Optimize animation' or make it shorter.
cpmplus.w34proa.split.fixPreview: Splits it into animations of up to 255 parts that play together on the same button (each bone chain whole in one piece). One Ctrl+Z undoes it.
cpmplus.w34proa.curl.menu.desc: Select the first bone of each chain (tail, tentacle, neck, fingers, feathers): curl, bend sideways, twist, make an S-wave or fan them out, with a live preview. Writes the pose at the current frame (or an animation up to it).
cpmplus.w34proa.curl.title: Curl chain / fan out
cpmplus.w34proa.curl.intro: %s chain(s): %s. The curl is added to the pose now (%s).
cpmplus.w34proa.curl.curl.desc: How much the whole chain rolls up, shared by the bones. + lifts a chain lying flat (tail, wing) and brings a hanging or standing one forward (hair, neck).
cpmplus.w34proa.curl.side.desc: Sideways curve (degrees in total). + moves a tail to +X; a sideways chain (wing) goes back.
cpmplus.w34proa.curl.fan.desc: Several chains (fingers, feathers): spreads them side by side, evenly (degrees between the first and the last). Negative closes them.
cpmplus.w34proa.curl.mode.ab: Animation from the pose now to the curled one
cpmplus.w34proa.curl.frames.desc: The curled pose goes this many frames after the playhead (the animation grows when needed). On these bones, rotation keys in between are removed.
cpmplus.w34proa.curl.twist.desc: Turns around the length of the chain (degrees in total).
cpmplus.w34proa.curl.swave.desc: Two opposite curves along the chain, like an S, each this big.
cpmplus.w34proa.curl.weight.desc: Which end bends more: + the tip, - the base, 0 all the same. The total stays the same.
cpmplus.w34proa.curl.nothing: Nothing to apply: every control is at 0.
cpmplus.w34proa.curl.summary: %s bones, %s rotation keys at the playhead.
cpmplus.w34proa.curl.summaryAb: %s bones, %s rotation keys (pose now + curled pose).
cpmplus.w34proa.curl.err.noChain: Select the first bone of each chain (e.g. the base of the tail, of each finger or of each feather) in Animate mode.
